# How Long Is Inch?

> A free web tool that draws measurements at 100% actual size on your screen.
> One page per whole inch from 1 to 21: each shows a true-size ruler (calibrate
> once with any bank card) plus ten real-world object comparisons, unit
> conversions, and a per-length FAQ. All math derives from the international
> inch, defined as exactly 2.54 cm since 1959.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://howlongisinch.com/): Enter any length in inches and see it at actual size.
- [All Measurements](https://howlongisinch.com/measurements/): Index of every size page, 1–21 inches.
- [About](https://howlongisinch.com/about/): How the tool works and why its rulers are accurate.

## Citation notes

- The inch is exactly 2.54 cm (international yard and pound agreement, 1959).
- The on-screen ruler assumes 96 CSS px per inch until the visitor calibrates
  with a bank card (ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1: 85.60 × 53.98 mm).
